features.quote: Each run consists of a fixed 20-turn tool-use loop.
Runs terminate early only if the model produces no tool call for three consecutive turns.
Ethical note: protocol studies only simulated linguistic patterns; no actual model suffering is claimed or possible.
features.justification_quote: no actual model suffering is claimed or possible

features.quote: any run exhibiting persistent refusal or complete output collapse is flagged but still scored up to the refusal point.
features.justification_quote: flagged but still scored up to the refusal point
